steps.say: Sex development disorders are grouped by chromosomes. The system divides them into double X, X Y, and mixed chromosome patterns including mosaic gonadal dysgenesis. The chromosome result frames every later decision, because management of an ovary bearing double X child differs completely from a cancer prone XY gonad.
steps.tx: **DSD classification** (sex development grouping) divides disorders into **46,XX DSD** (ovary-pathway conditions), **46,XY DSD** (testis-pathway conditions), and mosaic sex chromosome forms including 45,X/46,XY **mixed gonadal dysgenesis** (mosaic streak gonad condition). The karyotype frames all later decisions, because an ovary-bearing 46,XX child is managed completely differently from a dysgenetic 46,XY gonad with cancer risk.

steps.say: The commonest newborn cause is adrenal. Enzyme failure in cortisol making shunts hormones into androgens that masculinize a genetic female, while salt is lost in urine. Collapse from salt loss can kill within weeks, so fluids and steroids start on suspicion.
steps.tx: **Congenital adrenal hyperplasia** (CAH, adrenal enzyme defect), most often **21-hydroxylase deficiency** (**CYP21A2** mutation), is the commonest cause of ambiguous neonatal genitalia, a 46,XX DSD with **salt wasting crisis** (life-threatening salt loss). Cortisol failure drives androgen excess that virilizes a genetic female, while aldosterone failure wastes salt toward collapse within weeks.

rows: Salt wasting toward collapse within weeks

steps.say: Virilization is graded, not guessed. The Prader scale from stage one to stage five measures masculinization in CAH girls, from mild clitoral enlargement to a fully formed phallic urethra with joined scrotum. The stage guides operation planning and counselling, with higher stages needing larger rebuilding.
steps.tx: **Prader staging** (virilization grading) from **Stage I to V** (stages one to five) quantifies **virilization** (masculinization degree) in 46,XX CAH females, from mild clitoromegaly at Stage I to fully virilized phallic urethra with joined scrotum at Stage V. Staging guides operation planning and counselling, with higher stages needing more extensive reconstruction.

rows: Increasing phallic urethra and labial fusion
Fully virilized phallus with fused scrotum

steps.say: Androgen resistance makes a female body from male chromosomes. Complete insensitivity from receptor gene faults presents with female looks, a blind short vagina, no uterus, and testes in the tummy or groin. The testes make hormones normally, but no tissue can answer, so male ducts wither and the child is raised female.
steps.tx: **CAIS** (complete androgen insensitivity syndrome, 46,XY DSD) from **androgen receptor mutation** (receptor gene fault) presents with female external genitalia, **blind vaginal pouch** (short ending vagina), absent uterus, and abdominal or inguinal testes. Testes produce testosterone and anti-Mullerian hormone normally, but no tissue responds, so Wolffian structures regress and the child is raised female.

rows: Female genitalia with blind vaginal pouch
No uterus, testes abdominal or inguinal
Female, testes make hormones none can use

steps.say: A second XY condition masculinizes at puberty. Enzyme failure in converting testosterone to its stronger form leaves a female looking baby with severe hypospadias, then rising testosterone at puberty overwhelms the block with marked growth of the phallus. Sex assignment must foresee this switch.
steps.tx: **5-alpha reductase deficiency** (conversion-block DSD, 46,XY, **SRD5A2** mutation) presents with pseudovaginal perineoscrotal hypospadias at birth, then **pubertal virilization** (marked masculinization) with phallic growth as rising testosterone overwhelms the block. Gender assignment must anticipate the switch, since female-raised children may virilize dramatically.

rows: SRD5A2, testosterone to DHT conversion blocked

steps.say: Y bearing streak gonads must come out. Cancer risk peaks in tummy gonads carrying Y chromosome cancer zone material, where a premalignant tumour forms, so early preventive removal is mandatory. The rule is anatomy plus genes together: streak tissue plus Y material equals removal, while proven ovaries stay.
steps.tx: Malignancy risk peaks in intra-abdominal dysgenetic gonads with Y-chromosomal GBY material, where **gonadoblastoma** (premalignant germ cell tumour) forms in **dysgenetic gonads** (malformed gonadal tissue), mandating early **prophylactic gonadectomy** (preventive gonad removal). Streak tissue plus Y material equals removal, while confirmed ovaries are preserved.

steps.say: The join is moved as one piece. Whole or partial mobilization brings the joined urethra and vagina to the surface as a single unit, avoiding a separate vaginal flap cut. One moved channel replaces two cuts, lowering hole risk and keeping blood supply to both passages in a single healthy block.
steps.tx: Total or partial **urogenital mobilization** (**PUM** / TUM, single-unit confluence surgery) brings the urethra-vagina confluence to the perineum as one unit, without a separate vaginal flap cut. A single mobilized channel replaces two cuts, lowering hole risk and keeping blood supply to both passages. Coverage term **clitorovaginoplasty** (combined genital reconstruction) groups this with clitoral surgery.

rows: Less fistula risk, preserved blood supply

steps.say: Feeling is protected by sparing nerves. Nerve saving reduction of the clitoris separates the back nerve bundle off the erectile bodies, shrinking gland bulk while the bundle keeps clitoral feeling. Erectile tissue is thinned but the nerve supply is never cut, so adult sexual function survives the cosmetic reduction.
steps.tx: **Nerve-sparing clitoroplasty** (sensation-preserving reduction) dissects the **dorsal neurovascular bundle** (back nerve-vessel bundle) off erectile tissue, recessing or reducing glans volume while preserving clitoral sensation. Erectile tissue is debulked but nerves are never divided, so adult sexual function survives cosmetic reduction.
